name: QuickBooks Payments

sources.title: Intuit Payments Standard Pricing Schedule (U.S. only), Standard Customers — September 12, 2023
Credit Card Processing Fees & Rates Explained | QuickBooks (payment-rates page)

scope: QuickBooks Payments fees on QuickBooks Online (the same chart covers QuickBooks Money, GoPayment and the Gmail plug-in) for Standard customers, meaning accounts approved or first used on or after September 12, 2023. QuickBooks Desktop, the Payments API, Legacy customers and accounts with a negotiated rate are out of scope; their published rates are listed under Not included. QuickBooks Online subscription prices are a separate charge and are not part of this calculator.
structure: QuickBooks Payments takes a percentage of each payment, set by how your customer pays: 2.99% for an invoice paid by card or digital wallet (Apple Pay, PayPal, Venmo), 1% for an invoice paid by ACH bank transfer, 2.5% in person with a card reader or Tap to Pay, 3.5% for a card number typed in, and 1% for PIN debit. International cards and international PayPal accounts add 1%. The Standard QuickBooks Online chart has no monthly fee and no fixed per-transaction fee on card payments. Instant deposit costs 1.75% of the amount deposited. Intuit rounds each fee to the nearest cent.
summary: QuickBooks Payments takes 2.99% of invoices paid by card or digital wallet, 1% of invoices paid by ACH bank transfer with no maximum listed, 2.5% in person and 3.5% for typed-in cards, plus 1% for international cards. No monthly fee on the Standard QuickBooks Online chart; instant deposit costs 1.75%.

No. The rates listed are exactly the rates you’ll pay for making a credit card transaction, regardless if it’s Visa, MasterCard, Discover, or American Express, or if your customer is using a corporate card.
Rates are accurate as of 04/30/2026. All listed rates are per transaction.
Final fees are calculated based on the then-current rate and rounded to the nearest cent.

These pricing terms apply to customers (“Standard Customers”) that were approved or first used QuickBooks Payments (online or desktop), GoPayment, and/or Gmail plug-in processing services (collectively, “Services”) on September 12, 2023 or thereafter.
A per transaction fee may apply for each ACH or electronic bank payment, where applicable.

Legacy customers (merchant agreements on or before September 12, 2023, or 3-tier qualified pricing). Their rates follow an older schedule, such as the Qualified Pricing Schedule's $20 monthly fee with 1.69% / 2.52% / 3.96% tiers plus $0.30 per card transaction.
Negotiated rates after a pricing rate review, including the 'up to 25% off transaction costs' Intuit offers by phone to businesses processing over $2,500 a month.
Chargeback fee ($25 plus the full chargeback amount), ACH or electronic bank reject fee ($25), returned check ($10).
Payment dispute protection, an optional add-on ('Starting at .99%').
Buy now, pay later through Affirm (2.99% on the payment-rates page, which says the feature has limited availability); it is not in the Standard schedule chart.
QuickBooks Online subscription prices, which are billed separately from payment processing.
notes: Two Intuit pages agree on the QuickBooks Online rates: the Standard Pricing Schedule (last updated September 12, 2023) and the payment-rates page ('accurate as of 04/30/2026'). The calculator follows the legal schedule, and both pages are re-read nightly.

ACH: the Standard schedule lists 1% with no maximum. Accounts on older Legacy pricing had capped ACH fees, so if your account predates September 12, 2023 your rate may differ. The schedule also says a per-transaction fee 'may apply for each ACH or electronic bank payment, where applicable' without stating an amount; the calculator adds none.
The payment-rates page says card rates are the same for every brand, including American Express and corporate cards.
The 1% international surcharge applies to international cards and international PayPal accounts. The calculator adds it to card and wallet payments only, not to ACH.
Instant deposit is charged on the amount you choose to deposit. The calculator assumes you instantly deposit the whole payment after processing fees.
